title: The Globe Of The Earth Its Journey And The Proofs Of Mercy On The Page Of Spring

questions.question: What does the globe invite the traveler to look at first?
questions.answer: Its jobs and its signs, like pages to be read.

questions.question: What two kinds of movement does the globe have?
questions.answer: It has a double motion.

questions.question: What do these movements help measure?
questions.answer: They bring about days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: What picture is used to describe the globe in space?
questions.answer: It is pictured like a great ship traveling in space.

questions.question: What is this great ship loaded with?
questions.answer: It carries many kinds of food and supplies for living creatures.

questions.question: How is the globe moving in space?
questions.answer: It moves in balance while going around the sun.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice when he looks at the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: He sees that they point again and again to the Lord of the earth.

questions.question: Which page does he study more closely?
questions.answer: He studies the page about living things in spring.

questions.question: From what do the forms of many living things come out?
questions.answer: They come from a simple kind of material.

questions.question: How are these living things cared for after they appear?
questions.answer: They are raised with mercy and care.

questions.question: What happens to some seeds in a wondrous way?
questions.answer: They are given ways to fly and spread to other places.

questions.question: How are seeds and living things treated after being spread?
questions.answer: They are distributed well and fed and cared for carefully.

questions.question: From what unlikely things are many foods brought out?
questions.answer: They come from dry soil, roots, seeds, and small drops of liquid.

questions.question: What arrives every spring as if it were sent from a hidden storehouse?
questions.answer: Many kinds of food and needed supplies for living things.

questions.question: What example is given to show special mercy toward babies?
questions.answer: Babies are given milk, especially through their mothers.

questions.question: Why is a mother’s milk described as a sign of mercy and wisdom?
questions.answer: Because it is a gentle, loving, and perfectly suited gift for the baby.

questions.question: What does spring show about the earth after winter-like death?
questions.answer: It shows the earth being brought back to life.

questions.question: What larger truth does this spring page help the traveler understand?
questions.answer: The One who revives the earth can also bring the dead to life.

questions.question: What message does the earth give through all its pages?
questions.answer: That only Allah is truly worthy of worship.

questions.question: Why does the globe call the traveler back from the sky?
questions.answer: To show him on earth what he is searching for.

questions.question: What does the traveler do after hearing the globe’s call?
questions.answer: He looks at the earth’s work and reads its signs.

questions.question: How is the globe compared to a whirling dervish?
questions.answer: It is described as turning with two motions.

questions.question: What comes from the globe’s turning?
questions.answer: The order of day and night, the year, and the seasons.

questions.question: Why is the globe called a grand ship?
questions.answer: Because it carries huge amounts of provisions for creatures.

questions.question: Where is this ship traveling?
questions.answer: In space, while circling the sun.

questions.question: What does each page of the earth seem to do?
questions.answer: It declares the greatness and lordship of Allah.

questions.question: Why does the traveler focus on spring instead of all the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: Because he cannot read everything at once.

questions.question: What shows great precision in spring?
questions.answer: The many forms of countless living things appear exactly as needed.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the source material of many living forms?
questions.answer: They come from simple material, yet become many different shapes.

questions.question: What is amazing about some seeds?
questions.answer: Some are equipped to travel through the air.

questions.question: What happens after these seeds are spread?
questions.answer: They are placed, fed, and raised with care.

questions.question: What does the passage say about food coming from the earth?
questions.answer: Delicious foods are brought out from things that seem plain and similar.

questions.question: What comparison is used for springtime provision?
questions.answer: It is like loading a railcar with supplies and sending it out in order.

questions.question: Who receives these springtime supplies?
questions.answer: The living beings on earth.

questions.question: What example especially shows tenderness toward the young?
questions.answer: Infants receiving milk prepared for them through their mothers.

questions.question: What qualities are seen in this care for infants?
questions.answer: Loving care, mercy, and wisdom.

questions.question: How is spring connected to the idea of resurrection?
questions.answer: It is a visible example of life returning after lifelessness.

questions.question: What final belief does the traveler understand from the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: He understands that all creation points to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the globe say it will show the traveler?
questions.answer: It will show him what he has been looking for.

questions.question: How is the globe’s movement described in a lively image?
questions.answer: It is described like a spinning dervish.

questions.question: What pattern does the globe’s motion set up?
questions.answer: It sets the pattern of days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: In the passage, what makes the globe like a well-run vessel?
questions.answer: It carries what living things need and moves in a balanced way.

questions.question: What does the traveler learn by looking at the earth like a book?
questions.answer: He learns that its signs point to its Creator and Sustainer.

questions.question: Which part of this “book” does he inspect closely?
questions.answer: The springtime page about living creatures.

questions.question: What stands out about the birth of many species in spring?
questions.answer: So many forms appear from simple matter with exactness.

questions.question: How are these newly appearing creatures treated?
questions.answer: They are nourished in a merciful way.

questions.question: What special gift is given to some seeds?
questions.answer: They are given a way to travel through the air.

questions.question: What does the careful spreading of seeds suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests planning, care, and wise control.

questions.question: What kinds of things become food according to the passage?
questions.answer: Soil, roots, seeds, and tiny drops become many foods.

questions.question: How does the passage show that spring provision is abundant?
questions.answer: It says huge numbers of foods and supplies are sent each spring.

questions.question: What image is used for sending these supplies?
questions.answer: It is like goods being loaded onto a train car and sent out.

questions.question: Why is milk for babies a powerful example in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it shows loving care prepared exactly for their need.

questions.question: What does this example teach about Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: His mercy is gentle, generous, and wise.

questions.question: What does the spring page display many examples of?
questions.answer: It displays many signs of the great rising to life.

questions.question: How does reviving the earth support belief in life after death?
questions.answer: If dead-looking earth can live again, bringing people back to life is also possible.

questions.question: What short message do all the earth’s pages seem to announce?
questions.answer: That there is no god except Allah.

questions.question: What is the traveler told to read on the globe?
questions.answer: Its pages, meaning its signs and works.

questions.question: What does the globe’s two-part motion help create in human life?
questions.answer: It helps create the order of time and seasons.

questions.question: Why is balance important in the description of the globe?
questions.answer: Because it shows the earth moves through space in a steady, controlled way.

questions.question: What does the globe carry for living things?
questions.answer: It carries food and other needed provisions.

questions.question: Around what does the globe travel?
questions.answer: Around the sun.

questions.question: What does the traveler see in every chapter of the earth?
questions.answer: Signs that point to the Lord of the earth.

questions.question: Which season becomes the main example in the passage?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What happens to countless species in spring?
questions.answer: Their forms appear with great exactness.

questions.question: What is surprising about where these forms come from?
questions.answer: They come from simple material.

questions.question: What is done for some seeds so they can reach new places?
questions.answer: They are given wings or a way to fly.

questions.question: After being scattered, what happens to these seeds and living things?
questions.answer: They are fed and raised with great care.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the foods brought from the earth?
questions.answer: Many tasty foods come from plain-looking sources.

questions.question: How are spring gifts described as arriving?
questions.answer: As if they are sent from an unseen storehouse in perfect order.

questions.question: What example shows special care for babies?
questions.answer: Their milk is provided through their mothers.

questions.question: Why would this example touch a reader’s heart?
questions.answer: Because it shows loving and gentle care for helpless infants.

questions.question: What does spring prove about the earth?
questions.answer: That the earth can be brought to life after seeming dead.

questions.question: What does this sign teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: He has power over all things, including giving life.

questions.question: What belief does the traveler reach after reading the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: He reaches belief in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the globe promise to do for the traveler?
questions.answer: It promises to show him what he seeks.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice first about the globe?
questions.answer: Its double motion.

questions.question: What results from this motion on earth?
questions.answer: The sequence of days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: What comparison helps us imagine the earth in space?
questions.answer: A huge ship traveling with balance.

questions.question: What is on this ship for living beings?
questions.answer: Many kinds of food and useful things.

questions.question: What does the traveler realize from the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: They all give signs of the One who cares for the earth.

questions.question: Why does he choose one page to study?
questions.answer: Because the whole earth has too much to read at once.

questions.question: Which page does he choose?
questions.answer: The spring page about living creatures.

questions.question: What is remarkable about the many species in spring?
questions.answer: Their forms appear in a very exact way from simple stuff.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the care given to these creatures?
questions.answer: It is full of mercy and careful nurturing.

questions.question: What unusual help is given to some seeds?
questions.answer: They are enabled to travel like flying carriers.

questions.question: What does this spreading of seeds lead to?
questions.answer: Their effective distribution and careful growth.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the making of food?
questions.answer: Delicious foods are produced from dry earth and other simple things.

questions.question: How rich is the springtime provision described to be?
questions.answer: It includes vast numbers of foods and supplies.

questions.question: What picture is used to explain this provision?
questions.answer: It is like supplies loaded onto a wagon and sent out neatly.

questions.question: How are infants especially cared for?
questions.answer: They are given milk prepared for them through their mothers.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the One providing it?
questions.answer: He is merciful, generous, and wise.

questions.question: What does spring become a clear sign of?
questions.answer: Bringing life after death-like stillness.

questions.question: What statement does the earth seem to say through all its pages?
questions.answer: That only Allah is God.

questions.question: In the passage, what does the globe ask the traveler to stop doing?
questions.answer: Wandering through the heavens and space.

questions.question: What does the globe offer instead?
questions.answer: A chance to learn by looking at the earth’s own works and signs.

questions.question: What human image is used to describe the globe’s motion?
questions.answer: A whirling dervish.

questions.question: What three time patterns are linked to the globe’s movement?
questions.answer: Days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: Why is the globe described as a majestic ship?
questions.answer: Because it carries huge amounts of provisions for living creatures.

questions.question: What shows that this ship is not out of control?
questions.answer: It floats and moves with perfect balance.

questions.question: What does the traveler see in the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: Many signs pointing to the earth’s Sustainer.

questions.question: Which page receives special attention?
questions.answer: The page of spring and the life appearing in it.

questions.question: What do we learn about the making of living forms?
questions.answer: Many kinds are formed very precisely from simple material.

questions.question: How does the passage show mercy in nature?
questions.answer: New life is gently raised and provided for.

questions.question: What happens to some seeds so they can spread widely?
questions.answer: They are given means to fly.

questions.question: How are these seeds then handled?
questions.answer: They are spread effectively and cared for closely.

questions.question: What contrast is shown in the making of food?
questions.answer: Wonderful foods come from plain, dry, and similar-looking sources.

questions.question: What does the unseen treasury image teach?
questions.answer: That provision comes in an ordered way from a hidden source of mercy.

questions.question: What example is given from the lives of babies?
questions.answer: They receive milk suited to them from their mothers.

questions.question: What does this example reveal about divine care?
questions.answer: It is tender, thoughtful, and full of compassion.

questions.question: Why is spring called a living page?
questions.answer: Because it shows the earth becoming alive again with countless examples.

questions.question: What belief about the future does this help support?
questions.answer: That the dead can be brought to life again.

questions.question: What is the earth’s message, according to the traveler?
questions.answer: It declares Allah’s oneness through all its signs.
